What is the difference between App Control and Remote Control?

App Control connects to your smartphone via Bluetooth — you control colors and effects through a free app. Remote Control uses a handheld IR remote. App Control offers more features and modes. Remote Control is simpler to use without a phone.

How are they installed?

Each light unit has a self-adhesive backing — simply peel and stick under your dashboard or in each footwell. Power connects via the USB port in your car or the cigarette lighter adapter.

No — these LED lights consume very little power (under 5W total for all 4 units). They will not drain your battery.

Yes — universal fit. Works in Honda Civic, Toyota Corolla, Suzuki Alto, Honda City and any other car with a USB port or cigarette lighter socket.
